discrepancies.summary: The chip identifier is 0x8130 (t8130 in the ipsw database), but the package's monitor image is sptm.t8122.release.im4p and the kernel banner ends in RELEASE_ARM64_T8122. For the A18 Pro and A19 Pro the monitor token matches the chip identifier. Both facts are kept. The CPU name t8130 is a secondary-source label.

unresolved: No exact A17 Pro / 24A446 guest has been booted.
Hardware fidelity is unverified: darwin-vm uses a generic machine and QEMU's generic max CPU.
The CPU name t8130 is a secondary-source label and the monitor image is named t8122 (tracker claim C-159).
The unmodified darwin-vm preparation script does not find an SPTM image for this device (sptm.t8130 is absent, sptm.t8122 is present).
Preparing a bootable ramdisk needs macOS. This host is Linux.
Exact-model support for iPhone 15 Pro Max on iOS 27.0.1 is not documented for Corellium.
